task_description: Implement the OCCM Groups feature for Mastodon - private, local-only group functionality with self-moderation. Covers database schema, models, services, API controllers, streaming, frontend UI, and i18n in both English and Korean.

verification.summary: All Ruby files pass syntax checks (ruby -c). TypeScript compiles without errors (npx tsc --noEmit). Node.js streaming server passes syntax check (node --check). Semantic review completed (v1) and all critical issues fixed. RSpec cannot fully run due to missing libvips system dependency (pre-existing). 92 files changed, 4422 insertions across 7 features implementing all 12 phases of the OCCM Groups specification.
